title: Continuity of the Gaussian upper quantile
statement: For each probability level $\alpha\in(0,1)$, let $q(\alpha)$ be the unique real number whose standard Gaussian upper-tail probability is $\alpha$. The function $q:(0,1)\to\mathbb{R}$ is continuous.
